name: Young's Orchard and Berry Farm
description: Young's Orchard and Berry Farm is a pumpkin patch in 9899 FM 171, TX. Visitors come for Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, best in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
